run_load_model_from_xml: run a MuJoCo simulation by loading a model from an XML string using load_model_from_xml
run_MjSim: run a MuJoCo simulator by creating an MjSim instance from a loaded model
run_mj_saveLastXML: run the MuJoCo internal function mj_saveLastXML to save a model's XML to a file
run_mjv_room2model: run the MuJoCo internal function mjv_room2model to convert room coordinates to model coordinates
run_mju_quat2Mat: run the MuJoCo internal function mju_quat2Mat to convert a quaternion into a rotation matrix
